reviewed_formal_content.mechanism: Initial deadline 0 and first eligible stat-cache update permit the first applicable attack to consume the melee-power modifier. Damage is resolved using the currently selected held/cache value; the matching source-item + held + melee on_hit gate resets the deadline after damage. Six families use +60% and 5/4.5/4/3.5s; Cruncher Krourk Mk IIa uses +17.5/+20/+22.5/+25% and 2s. Pure push is not the melee consumer/reset. On the Saw, direct sticky hits can reset; delayed rip profiles skip the hit trigger but may read the current held/cache melee-power value when the delayed damage is resolved.
reviewed_formal_content.switching: Switching leaves the deadline running while held-slot disables the source stat. Switching back can restore contribution if the deadline has expired and cache updated. Unequipping the source weapon removes its on-equip source buff.
reviewed_formal_content.math: B=500,q=0 examples yield 800 for a +60% family and 625 for Hammer IV +25%; these are power-stage inputs, not final HP damage. At t=10 a qualifying IV hit sets 13.5s after its damage; a hit at t=12 is ineligible for the stat but still resets to 15.5s.
reviewed_formal_content.raw: Four-tier static reconstructions preserve the paired English/Traditional Chinese RAW and formatter output; value/time format and prefix match. Conditions, event timing, switching, and delayed-rip profile behavior are omissions rather than RAW contradictions.
reviewed_formal_content.image: The actual icon 188 image receipt is included in scope and records the supplied attachment/public-copy hash and visual verification.
